decisions.reason: As a flagship organic line that stayed visible from launch through 2024 and matches the firm's stated expansion in organic products, it is very unlikely to be withdrawn soon.

The premium salami snack line still appears on the website and fits the firm's broad charcuterie assortment, though its reduced prominence versus launch suggests a somewhat higher pruning risk than the core organic focus products.
This newly launched organic Fleischwurst sits squarely in the firm's bio direction and established sausage competence, so management would usually give it more time on the market.
The organic thin-sliced chicken breast line supports both the organic push and demand for convenient, lighter cold cuts, making continuation the likely choice.

The organic herb-coated salami is close to the firm's core salami strengths and current organic strategy, although as a more niche variant it carries a modestly higher discontinuation risk than the main bio launches.
